title: Watch Wear Rotation Imbalance
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:item
| search wear_share_pct=*
| stats avg(wear_share_pct) as wear_share_pct count as wear_events by brand
| sort 0 - wear_share_pct
description: Ranks brandss by watch wear imbalance.
value: Rotation imbalance helps show whether the collection is giving you variety or just expensive favorites.
implementation: Send watch wear imbalance events to `index=personal` and keep `brand` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of watch wear imbalance by brands.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which brandss stand out most for watch wear imbalance.
